panel.accessDenied: This area is for an MFA-authenticated Platform administrator.
panel.stepUpDescription: This session has not proved your second factor yet. Enter a code from your authenticator to continue.

invite.label: Invite an administrator
invite.acknowledgement: If that address can be invited, an invitation is on its way

audit.title: Audit
audit.empty: Nothing has been recorded here yet.
audit.label: Audit

identities.title: Identities
identities.accessDenied: This screen is for a Platform administrator holding platform.identities.read.
identities.recentProof: That change needs a fresh proof of your second factor. Enter a code, then ask for it again.

reactivation.acknowledgementRequired: This account was parked by the person who owns it. Lifting the suspension returns it there, not to active. Tick the acknowledgement if you mean to do that.
reactivation.acknowledgement: I understand this account may return to deactivated rather than active

register.title: Set up your Platform account
register.missingToken: This invitation link is incomplete. Open it again from the invitation email.
register.success: Check your email. If that invitation is still open, we have sent you what you need to continue. Confirm your address, sign in, then open this invitation link again to set up your second factor.

confirm.title: Confirm your Platform address
confirm.success: Your address is confirmed. Sign in, then open your invitation email again to set up your second factor.

bootstrap.title: Resend the Platform owner invitation
bootstrap.success: If an owner invitation is waiting and could not be delivered, a new one is on its way.

mfa.signInWithInvitedAddress: Sign in with the invited address, then open your invitation email again.
mfa.savedRecoveryCodes: I have saved my recovery codes

recovery.title: Replace your second factor
recovery.description: Use this if you have lost the authenticator. You need your password and one unused recovery code.
recovery.signInFirst: Sign in first. Replacing a second factor needs your password as well as a recovery code.
recovery.replacementReady: Add this key to your authenticator and save the codes. They are shown once and cannot be shown again.
recovery.proveNewFactor: Prove the new factor before making any Platform change: nobody has proved it yet, including you.

retention.title: Retention
retention.accessDenied: This screen needs the platform.retention.read permission. Ask a Platform owner to grant it.
retention.entryProof: This session has not proved your second factor yet. Enter a code from your authenticator to read the retention policy.
retention.recentProof: That change needs a recent proof of your second factor. Confirm it, then make the change again.
retention.noPolicy: No retention policy is configured for this deployment, so nothing will be erased.
retention.emptyCategories: This policy names no categories of its own.

place.title: Place a hold
place.referenceShape: Letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon or hyphen — 1 to 64 characters.
place.validation: A reason code and a reference are each: {{shape}} Nothing was sent.
place.receipt: Hold {{holdId}} is placed for {{reasonCode}} under reference {{reference}}, at {{placedAt}}. Keep that hold id: nothing lists holds, so this is the only time it is shown.

release.title: Release a hold
release.prompt: Release this hold? Nothing about it is read back first — the route answers the same way whether it stands, was already released, or never existed.
release.notice: This hold is released. A hold that was already released and one that never existed answer exactly the same way, so this says what is true now — not that this request changed anything.
